# Research Methodology Corpus

## Document: Empirical Research Principles
SourceID: src_research_001
Authority: PRIMARY
Domain: research_methodology

### Section: Experimental Variables and Validity
An independent variable is the factor deliberately manipulated by the experimenter.
A dependent variable is the outcome variable measured to assess the effect of the manipulation.
Controlled variables are all extraneous factors maintained at constant levels to prevent confounding effects.
Internal validity represents the degree to which observed experimental effects can be unambiguously attributed to the independent variable rather than confounding variables.
A literature synthesis identifies empirical consensus, theoretical contradictions, and unresolved research gaps across peer-reviewed studies.
